input.question: Why the older or more famous older actor of a cast is often appearing last in the credits and with a and in front of the name. example : blablabla AND Robert DeNiro
input.ground_truth: Calls more attention to it as a special cast member. "Look, viewers! Sure we got all these other people. But we scored ROBERT DENIRO!" They often do it in recurring series where that actor will be showing up in future shows because it both attracts fans of that actor and adds legitimacy to the show because it attracted such a big name.
